review_description: We sourced our Solar System upgrade from Solar Earth (Mindarie, WA).We chose them as they were recommended by friends, local provider, quality components, great installation.Installation was pretty tidy. 2 weeks after the install, I cleaned out the gutters (prior to winter rains) and noted some errant fittings from the install (or maybe from the removal of our old system).The whole process from quoting, to install, to after sales/install follow up has been first class.All paperwork for the install was completed by Solar Earth. The process could not have been easier.

very knowledgeable sales personnel, friendly installers, trusted them to do the install whilst I went shopping. Was not disappointed, great installation.  They avoided the part of the roof that got shade from a tree.Performance so far is better than expected, has been running for a week now. I chose the Bosch panels.
Not an expert in this field, as such can't comment on the quality of the product that I got.
